correctness.rationale: The two HJ strings are obtained by direct specialization of Alexeev--Liu's formula for T(a1,a2,a3,a4). Exact determinant recursions give orders 73 and 87 and tail determinants 66 and 70. The local canonical-index formula r/gcd(r,1+q) gives local indices 73 and 87, hence global index 6351. For plurigenera, the discrepancy coefficients are the unique exact solutions of M b=(2-e), and substitution into the Blache correction formula with chi=1 and K^2=1/6351 yields integral nonnegative P_n. Every n from 2 through 98 is checked exactly; P_1=0 follows from rationality.

originality.rationale: The 2019 source constructs the same surface and records its resolution strings and volume, while the 2026 source proves uniqueness and states the general Blache plurigenus formula. Neither inspected source states the global canonical index, the index-volume identity, or the thresholds P_11=1 and P_98=2. Exact object/name/number searches and published-index searches did not locate an equivalent statement. Because the surface is classical enough to have appeared since 2019, possible unindexed canonical-ring computations remain an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: The equality surface has been known since 2019, so an unindexed or differently phrased canonical-ring computation could contain the same early plurigenera.
The result does not determine base loci or birationality, so 'first moving degree' is used only in the precise sense of first positive projective dimension, not mobility in the base-point-free sense.

value.rationale: The 2026 uniqueness theorem elevates T(2,2,4,10) from an extremal example to the unique surface at the sharp volume bound. The canonical index and first two pluricanonical thresholds are natural intrinsic invariants of this distinguished object. The degree 98 threshold is not a one-line consequence of the volume: it depends on the periodic local corrections from the two quotient singularities and requires exhaustive exact comparison through degree 97. It gives concrete information about the onset of the canonical ring precisely in the pluricanonical direction emphasized by the recent source.
